_comment: Copy to the api_data volume as mcp_servers.json to enable MCP integrations:
then POST /mcp/discover (or restart the worker) to pick up the tools.
SECURITY: every tool from these servers defaults to REQUIRE_APPROVAL.
A third-party MCP server's tool is remote code execution with your
credentials attached. Setting trusted:true lets its read-only-looking
tools run without asking you first - only do that for servers you
Tool descriptions from a server land in the model's context. A hostile
server can put instructions there. Descriptions are capped and marked
with their provenance, but that is mitigation, not immunity.
